status: prospective relative to phase6 computation, post hoc relative to phase4/5 data review
training_split: development conversation text only; no questions, answers, evidence IDs, event summaries or observations
method: TF-IDF word unigrams followed by 64-dimensional truncated SVD (LSA), normalize individual turn vectors, compare means of adjacent three-turn windows by one-minus-cosine
segment_size_policy: the same greedy boundary selection and 64/128/160 word constraints as frozen lexical event method; oversized single turns preserved
semantic_feature_policy: Only conversation turn text; do not claim direct goal, causal, temporal or philosophical understanding
primary_comparison: LSA segmentation versus frozen lexical event segmentation at 1024 words, using identical BM25 code and whole-segment packing
primary_metric: question-level all-evidence recall, averaged as paired conversation rates across the same seven previously examined conversations
inference_policy: exploratory only; report paired differences, descriptive discordances, an exact sign-flip reference calculation and all conversation rates without confirmatory p-value interpretation
development_policy: development is for technical verification only; no hyperparameter selection after seeing outcome
failure_audit: gold-bearing segment word cost, feasible missed, structural budget, multi-evidence fragmentation and selected word cost
online_claim_policy: retrospective indexing only; a separate causal writer is needed for online agent memory
external_validation: optional future study, not a requirement for reporting this exploratory phase
output_policy: never overwrite phases 1-5 or store source conversation text, questions, answers, embeddings, model matrices or gold IDs in git
